title: Sequence to Sequence Reward Modeling: Improving RLHF by Language Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the length of generated responses against a supervised fine-tuning (Init-SFT) baseline on the Dialogsum dataset to measure the model's tendency to generate disproportionately longer text to exploit reward models.

Evaluating the trade-off between safety and utility on the PKU-SafeRLHF dataset using proxy utility models and MT Bench to detect if the model falls into an overly conservative 'refusal-to-response' paradigm.
